text: Interwetten is an online betting operator run via Interwetten Gaming Ltd (Malta). In December 2018, iGaming trade press described Wolfgang Fabian as the founder and majority owner of Interwetten; no change of control since then was found in an accessible secondary source.
short: Founder Wolfgang Fabian described as majority owner of Interwetten (2018).

source.name: 5 Star iGaming Media: Dominik Beier becomes CEO of Interwetten
source.quote: the founder and majority owner of Interwetten, Wolfgang Fabian, initiates the generational change
